prompt: What was state of the schools regarding integration in the hometown of Miller Williams when he began his master's degree in Zoology?
answer: When Miller Williams began his master’s degree in zoology at the University of Arkansas—around **1952**—the schools in his hometown of **Hoxie, Arkansas, were still segregated**. Hoxie’s schools did not begin integrating until **1955**, making the district one of the first in Arkansas to do so after *Brown v. Board of Education*.
